steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Negative in zones E31 and E32. Possible positive in zone 30...

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Hey, are you okay?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: I'm fine, just a little dizzy...

steps.name: Angry Miner
steps.text: Let me guess, fatigue?

steps.name: Angry Miner
steps.text: That bloody Cowell thinks we're burdenbeasts.

steps.name: Angry Miner
steps.text: There are so many of us here. We should be burying our pickaxes in his skull, not these rocks!

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Shh! Not so loud. His men are nearby.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Who knows what they might do if they hear you?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Yeah, it's okay... don't worry about me. I can take it...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Let me handle it. You take a break, see if Leonhardt needs anything.

steps.name: Angry Miner
steps.text: That Catastrophe Messenger has it easy!

steps.name: Angry Miner
steps.text: It's his fault that we got kidnapped and taken here in the first place!

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing? Slacking off?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: But what? Know your place.

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: You're hostages!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey now, take it easy.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Put yourself in his shoes. What's left of them, anyway...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Imagine if you were a miner who got packed into a crate like ore, dragged to this dangerous Catastrophe zone, and made to bang on rocks without rest.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: It's exhausting just thinking about it, am I right? Like, just saying it made me feel so tired I can hardly talk anymore...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So why not let them have a little break, my good man? I'm sure they'll work even harder afterwards.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Or, say, maybe we could do it this way. I'll go look for veins, and if I find something, we could get the miners to—

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: That's enough out of you, brat.

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: There's only a small window when the veins are exposed after a Catastrophe. Timing is everything in the competition for mining rights.

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: Don't think I don't know what you're thinking. You want to sit on your thumbs until Maize Drill sends a rescue and steals what we know about the veins!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Wait, wasn't it Cowell who kidnapped you all? Why would the miners blame you?

spans.text: Wait, wasn't it Cowell who kidnapped you all? Why would the miners blame

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Eh, learning to deal with people getting upset is like Catastrophe Messenger 101.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: And hey, I couldn't persuade the guards, so... I get it. Perfectly understandable.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But hadn't you been helping them, mate?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Well, not for very long, I hadn't... Maybe they'd have listened to Cruise Jr.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey, now there's a familiar name.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Wasn't he the one who sent you a thank-you letter? The one you read to us?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Oh? Ahaha... did I read his letter to you guys?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You did. I remember.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Ah... I thought I only read it to the girls at Medical...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Well, it wasn't just his letter. There were many others. I can see how you'd forget which ones you'd read.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: So, why do you keep bringing up this Cruise Jr.? Was he the real culprit behind the scenes?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hm? That can't be right. He sounded to me like the kinda guy you can count on.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: In terms of narrative, someone in his position isn't necessarily the antagonist. He could also have a positive influence on the protagonist's actions.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: All we can infer from what we know is that he played an important role in this event.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, what's with all this attention on Cruise Jr.? This is about MY heroic exploits!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, is that... Ayers!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Ayers! Over here!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Stop shouting, Leon.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: I knew you were here. I could hear you babbling about your 'heroic exploits' from the cafeteria entrance.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Cowell would have cut your head off if you were half as noisy when you were kidnapped.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Cowell? Wait, so the story is true?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: ...Parts of it, maybe? I haven't heard this version yet.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You can take my seat then. I need to return a book to Sonya.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Well then, Kroos and I will also...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, don't go! I'm not finished!

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: What do you need, sir?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Huh? Ah, just hold these for me. You can sit down over there, take a break. Oh, and check if there are any notable cracks on the walls while you're at it.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Take a break? So you overheard us talking...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Yeah, I did. No need to worry about my feelings though, we Catastrophe Messengers are tougher than we look. Mm-hmm.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: If Cowell's men ask, I made you do this.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So take a break. Keep that up, and your lungs will only get worse.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Thank you, sir.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: All my years of hardship would it worth it, if the young folks of Rim Billiton all grow up like you.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: And Ayerscarpe... he can be aloof, but there's something about him that's different from the other guards.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: When I fell behind earlier... he saw through how sick I was and helped me carry my stuff.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: My lungs have been giving out for a few years now, but mining is the only thing I know...

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: I haven't told anyone except Cruise Jr. Didn't want to be seen as useless.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Well... Ayers and I grew up together on a mining ship.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So how should I put it...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I managed to grab this before Cowell burned our camp. Have you seen it before?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: This is... did it belong to Ayerscarpe?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Yeah, he puts his edamame inside.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Edamame?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hilarious, isn't it? He looks so tough, but he has such a soft spot for the stuff.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: When we were little, we knew an old man around the mines who had a lung disease.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: He sold snacks next to the mine because he couldn't go in anymore. Grease and smoke were too much for him too, so he made stuff like salt-boiled edamame.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: And he always gave kids like us extra.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Only when we grew up did we learn how little he made.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So for me and Ayers, miners are kind of like family... well, close neighbors, at least.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Leonhardt...

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: L-Leonhardt! Are you there?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hm? What's wrong?

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Cowell's men are taking Luca away! Cruise is trying to stop them!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Wait, there's a new character? Who's this Luca?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It's gotta be that 'Angry Miner' guy from before, right?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Oh, you mean the guards overheard the miners talking?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Well, I don't know the full picture... All I know is that Cowell's men had Cruise Jr. surrounded and were beating him up when I arrived.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Because he wouldn't let them take Luca away?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Cowell wanted to make an example of him. Show what happens to people who speak up.

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: Thank you for saving me... even after all I said about you...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: No worries. Cowell wouldn't exactly refuse to trade a miner for a new ore deposit.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Cruise Jr. is the one you should thank. He put himself on the line for you, against so many burly guys too.

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: You're right...

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: So... how is he?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Still out cold.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: He has a broken arm and quite a few bumps and bruises, but no harm to any vital organs, fortunately.

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: Damn it... that bastard Cowell and his goons...

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Please, Luca! Just keep your head down, and we might see daylight again...

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Get on Cowell's bad side, and we're all dead men walking!

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: I heard Cowell has a female bodyguard...

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Former assassin. Real nasty stuff... There was a young entrepreneur who got into a bidding war with him at an auction.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: The bodyguard cut the guy's arms off. In front of everyone.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Why would someone like that take orders from a man like Cowell?

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Apparently, she has friends and family working for Cowell Mining... He must be holding them hostage.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: He's pretty paranoid and likes to keep a firm grasp on his subordinates. The mine guards are probably the same.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: But I haven't seen any female subordinates around him... strange.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: ...Maybe she's watching us from the shadows.

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: I would've said you were full of shit, if I hadn't seen Ayerscarpe in action.

steps.name: Luca
steps.text: After seeing him fight a whole regiment, though... I wouldn't be surprised if Cowell had someone like that under his command.

steps.name: Timid Miner
steps.text: Who knows which of 'em would have the upper hand if they came face-to-face... but I'm guessing a former assassin knows some dirty tricks.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You give me too little credit, Leon.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: But that's checkmate isn't it?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: If it's someone not even Ayerscarpe can handle...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Wouldn't you be stuck in that mine at Cowell's mercy?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Let's see how the protagonist gets out of this predicament.

spans.text: Let's see how the protagonist gets out of

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Well, that's not the important part... the bodyguard was a ghost who never even appeared. But I made an even more shocking discovery in the mines...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: What was it?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Explosives.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Cowell was waiting for Maize Drill to send rescue, then he'd blow us all up together.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Maybe you could have dealt with the guards, Ayers, but could you stop an explosion?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: This is getting a little scary...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Zzz... zzz...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Kroos...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Kroos?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: She dozed off.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Let her sleep. I feel it's going to be a while before we get to the good part.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, are you implying that wasn't a good part?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: An unarmed miner, bravely making a stand against the evil mine owner and his hired muscle!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Inspired by his act of courage, the Catastrophe Messenger heads towards a showdown with the villain!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: (Yawns)

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Did you just... yawn at me? I sure hope that was the fun kind of yawn.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Oh, sorry, couldn't resist... I must have eaten a little too much...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Let them off the hook, Leon.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Isn't tormenting me enough?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: So, how did you propose to deal with the explosives, Leonhardt?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: He caused a massive explosion.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, spoilers! We're not there yet! Good storytelling is about the journey!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So, this is where the detonation switch should be...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Number 26. Any more in this area...?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Leonhardt...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Oh, you're awake! Does it hurt anywhere?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I'm much better. It's just the arm... There's no need to do all this for me, Leonhardt.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Stay put. You have a broken forearm.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: ...What're those?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Oh? Well... these are transmitters I use to detect Catastrophe movement.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I used to be an engineer in the army. Those are explosives, aren't they?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Did Cowell do this?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Most likely. There must be seventy, eighty bundles in this hole. Enough to flip this entire place upside down, and us along with it.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Good thing they're not the type that explode on contact...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I can help. I've defused explosives before.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Not with that arm you can't. There are better ways to be a tough guy.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Look.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: ...Originium Arts?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: I can't believe you destroyed the detonators with such precision from such a distance.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Completely undetectable, too. No alarms raised.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: But it's all over if they see you fiddling around down here and decide to press the BOOM button.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Head back and join up with the rest. The company will send rescue soon.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Leonhardt...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Will the company really send help?

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Most of us are on short-term contracts with Maize Drill.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: No one expected this, the whole Catastrophe and vicious competition between corporations...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: To tell you the truth, though... most of us in this group are still owed wages.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: The workers disappear, no more wages owed, there's evidence implicating a competitor...

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Wouldn't that be rather convenient for the higher ups?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: No worries, you're talking to a super experienced Catastrophe Messenger here! I'll find a way to get you home.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Listen, Cruise. I've got a plan, but I need your help.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: The guards still think you're out cold, so you're the best man for the job.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: W-What is it? I'll do whatever I can.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Do you remember the way in?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I'll create a diversion while you go back the way we came.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Wait for Ayers at the entrance. He'll help you get out of here.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: And... give him this.

steps.name: Cruise Jr.
steps.text: Your clothes? There's blood on them... are you hurt?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Just a little scratch.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Pass on a message, too.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: 'Stay away, Ayers. Forget the contract. Leave this to me.'

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Honestly, I find it hard to picture those words coming out of your mouth.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, I got all the miners out safely! I'm not all talk, I've got the receipts!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: So, about the explosion...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Heh, now that was my genius plan!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I overheard the guards say that Cowell kidnapped me because his Catastrophe Messenger died in an accident.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: He was really anxious to claim that mine... but the only person in the area who knew about the Catastrophe's movements was me, employed by Maize Drill.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So he knew nothing about the Catastrophe situation. And I happened to be a Catastrophe Messenger. The rest, as they say, is history.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Huh? So you led him into a Catastrophe area?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: What? No! I would never! I'm a professional too, I've got standards!

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: You were the sole authority on Catastrophes present. So you faked one?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: H-Hey, how did you guess my genius plan?!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: But how do you fake a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: The explosion. Leonhardt used Originium Arts to cause explosions, then told Cowell that the tremors were caused by a Catastrophe.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Exactly! I was observing the rock formations in the mine while surveying, in order to identify locations where I could create an explosion without compromising the structural stability. And...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: There was one more important point.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: ...What was it?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The explosives.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Now this is getting a little interesting.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Cowell may not have felt threatened by the aftershocks of a Catastrophe on their own. He knew, however, that there were explosives set up all around the mine.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: B-But what about the workers? Weren't they scared? Didn't they want to flee with you?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: The lives of Rim Billiton's miners are threatened by much more than a mere Catastrophe.

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Compared to becoming chips... or rather, expendable fodder in the competition between mining companies...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Staying behind was the better option.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Now I understand... I suppose that's one way to 'rescue' them.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Yup, the miners would be safe, as long as Cowell and his men were gone from the mine.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Cowell thought he could hold them hostage as long as he still had the detonation button.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Little did he know that I had already defused the explosives!

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: W-What's going on?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Is it a Catastrophe? Leonhardt?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: No, I did it.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Look at Cowell's men panic.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I'm guessing they'll be looking for me to take them somewhere safe.

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: But a commotion like that...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Trust me. I need you guys to help out too.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Once Cowell's men take me away, gather the others and make sure they don't leave this area.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Tell them it's part of the Catastrophe Messenger's plans.

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: Catastrophe Messenger! The boss is looking for you.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: See? What did I tell you?

steps.name: Mine Guard
steps.text: Move it! Now!

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Leo—

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: Leonhardt!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hm? What is it?

steps.name: Tired Miner
steps.text: We'll see each other again, won't we?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: We'll see each other again, safe and sound!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: And so the brave Catastrophe Messenger lured the villains away from the shelter he had prepared for the miners, and stood alone, steadfast, against Cowell's terrifying fangs...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Alone?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: ...The brave Catastrophe Messenger, and his trusty bodyguard.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The guards would've beat you to a pulp if I hadn't arrived when I did.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Come on, I could've dealt with a few grunts on my own.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Now, I'll grant you that things wouldn't have gone so well if that bodyguard of Cowell's was around... Indeed, they could've gone very, very badly for me...

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Zzz....

steps.name: Istina
steps.text: Zzz....

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Zzz....

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hey, they've all fallen asleep!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Ha.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Don't laugh!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I was wondering why you sat here listening to me, when you've already heard the story a dozen times.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Now I get it.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: You were waiting to laugh at me!

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: The story is different each time you tell it. I've lost track of how many embellishments you've made.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: You're depicting Cowell as an evil but stupid comedic villain, in order to give the impression that you're making a noble sacrifice.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Well, I can't exactly get into the gory details, can I?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: It's enough that they know he's a really, really bad guy, right?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Yup.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: No matter which version you tell, though, it always ends with me saving the day.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Feeling a little verbose today, aren't you, Ayers?

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: Leon.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: It's okay to make someone worry.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: There are some things you don't need to hide.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Incidentally, Cowell's obituary appeared in the papers not long after that incident.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: At first, I was pissed that he got away, but I guess karma caught up to him in the end.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: So, Ayers.

steps.name: Ayerscarpe
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Do you REALLY not know anything about how Cowell died?
